data.text: King Ahasuerus imposed tribute on the land and the islands of the sea.

All the acts of his power and might, and the detailed account of the greatness of Mordecai, whom the king had exalted—are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Media and Persia?
For Mordecai the Jew was second to King Ahasuerus, great among the Jews and esteemed by many of his brothers. He sought the good of his people and spoke for the peace of all his descendants.
